Class RateLimitRule

java.lang.Object
com.linecorp.centraldogma.server.RateLimitRule
public final class RateLimitRule extends Object
A token bucket's capacity and refill rate, expressed as a request count per time unit. Buckets start full and refill gradually, up to their capacity. A count of -1 allows unlimited requests, and 0 rejects all requests. Global limits omit the pattern; repository rules require a pattern matched against the entire projectName/repoName and give each repository its own token bucket.

  • Constructor Details

    • RateLimitRule

      public RateLimitRule(long requests, TimeUnit timeUnit)
      Creates a global limit with capacity requests, replenishing that many tokens per timeUnit. A count of -1 allows unlimited requests, and 0 rejects all requests. The count must be at least -1, and both properties are required.

    • RateLimitRule

      public RateLimitRule(@Nullable String pattern, long requests, TimeUnit timeUnit)
      Creates a limit with an optional repository pattern, bucket capacity and refill time unit. The pattern must be null for a global limit and nonempty for a repository rule. A count of -1 allows unlimited requests, and 0 rejects all requests. The count must be at least -1, and both requests and timeUnit are required.
